atomic_facts.fact: The full legal name of Binance is Binance Holdings Limited.
Binance Holdings Limited pleaded guilty to US criminal charges.
The guilty plea / plea agreement occurred in November 2023 (November 21, 2023).
Binance agreed to pay approximately $4.3 billion.
The SEC filed a civil lawsuit against Binance Holdings Limited.
The SEC lawsuit was filed on June 5, 2023.
The SEC lawsuit constitutes a major regulator enforcement action.
